doc.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23

title: Blues singers visiting New Orleans: Bessie Smith, Clara Smith, Ida Cox
summary: He remembers seeing Bessie Smith's first visit and other blues singers, and mentions Louis Armstrong and Zutty Singleton.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens
